test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 16 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

“I have heard the podcast before,” Nita says.

options.text: Nita says that she is hearing the podcast before.
Nita says that she had heard the podcast before.
Nita says that she has heard the podcast before.
Nita says that she had heard the podcast ago.

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here, Nita's **experience of having heard** the podcast before is still a relevant fact when she is reporting it, so the **present perfect tense** ("has heard") will be retained in the reported speech.
 
• When the Direct Speech is in **Present Tense** (in this case, 'says') or **Future Tense,** there is** no change** in the Indirect Speech.
 
• **'Has'** will be used instead of **'Have'** as we use '**Has'** with singular noun or singular pronoun.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'Nita says that she has heard the podcast before.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **"Nita says that she is hearing the podcast before."** : This is incorrect because "is hearing" is present continuous tense, which doesn't fit the meaning of the sentence, and "before" can't be used with this tense in this context.
 
• **"Nita says that she had heard the podcast before."** : This is not incorrect, but it's more common to use "has heard" in this context for the reasons explained above.
 
• **"Nita says that she had heard the podcast ago."** : This is incorrect because "ago" is not used with the past perfect tense. It's used with the past simple tense to indicate how much time has passed since an event. Also, the word "before" is missing from the sentence.
